# Pinpoint Accounting & Service, Ltd.

> Bilingual accounting, tax, DBD, visa/work permit, licensing, and company dissolution services in Thailand.

## Service focus
- Monthly accounting and tax compliance for Thai and foreign-owned businesses in Thailand.
- Bangkok accounting office presence with Huai Khwang, Ratchada, and wider Bangkok service intent.
- Company registration, DBD amendments, and company dissolution support.
- Visa, work permit, and business license coordination.
- Thai and English client communication.

## Content patterns
- Blog articles include bilingual Thai/English content, executive summaries, and reference-source links.
- FAQ answers cover onboarding, service scope, English communication, and mobile compatibility.
- Service pages explain accounting, tax, DBD, visa/work permit, licensing, and dissolution scope.
